title: Adorable Golden Ornament
text: Adorable Golden Ornament. I was searching for the perfect Christmas tree ornament for my parents (yeah, I said it - Christmas tree, not holiday tree! Please don't sue me!) - and wasn't disappointed when I received this in the mail. It's well-crafted and really adorable, and has a decent weight to it without being too heavy for the tree. My parents will be thrilled with it!
